0x19ab453c.notice: Runs the Chronicle adapter + access-control module initializers. MUST be invoked via the diamond's `initialize` `_init` delegatecall.

params.admin: The address granted `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` (controls the feed registry).

natspec.notice: One-shot initializer for a Chronicle price-feed adapter diamond — seeds AccessControl (so the feed registry setters are admin-gated) and registers the IChronicleAdapter interface (ERC-165). Delegatecalled by {Diamond.initialize} inside the initializing window (so it must NOT open its own pre/postInitializer; each `__*_init` guard passes because the window is already open). Chronicle oracles are registered later via `registerFeed`, so no external reference is needed at init time.
